fixes.title: Remove duplicate relationships
fixes.description: The same predecessor/successor pair linked more than once with the same type.
fixes.effect: Deletes the extra TASKPRED rows, keeping the first of each.

fixes.title: Remove self-referencing logic
fixes.description: Relationships where an activity is its own predecessor.

fixes.title: Correct negative lags (leads)
fixes.description: Leads pull a successor forward and hide float; many specifications ban them.
fixes.effect: Rewrites lag_hr_cnt. Dates will move when P6 reschedules.

options.label: Lag in hours
options.help: XER stores lag in hours, not days.

fixes.title: Zero remaining duration on completed work
fixes.description: Finished activities that still carry remaining duration inflate the forecast.
fixes.effect: Sets remain_drtn_hr_cnt to 0 where status is TK_Complete.

fixes.title: Resolve hard constraints
fixes.description: Mandatory Start/Finish constraints override network logic and can hide negative float.
fixes.effect: Rewrites cstr_type. Dates will move when P6 reschedules.

options.label: What to do with each constraint

choices.label: Relax it (Mandatory Start to Start On or After, Mandatory Finish to Finish On or Before)

fixes.title: Zero milestone durations
fixes.description: Milestones mark an instant and should not carry duration.
fixes.effect: Sets target and remaining duration to 0 on milestone activities.
